body.name: Functional-support trace-grammar handle
body.construction: Construct \(\mathcal H_{\mathrm{FS}}\) by adapting recursive ancestral restriction and district decomposition while retaining every partial deletion trace; label each trace by its reachable observed support relation, its equality classes of functional response rows, and the exact residual query; terminal failures are converted into bounded forest-supported response obstructions rather than being declared by semantic nonidentifiability.
